title: Nara Park, deer and Todaiji
summary: A big open park where about 1,300 wild deer walk among the visitors. At one end is Todaiji, a huge wooden hall with a 15 m bronze Buddha. A half day from Kyoto or Osaka, any day.
why: The classic Kansai half day, easy by train, and it works on any day of the route west, not only on the festival night.
cost: Todaiji Great Buddha Hall ¥800; deer crackers ¥200; Kintetsu train from Kyoto about ¥760 or from Osaka Namba about ¥680 each way
winterNote: Open all year. Winter mornings are quiet and the deer are hungry. On Sat Jan 23, 2027 the park is crowded for the hill-burning festival (see that idea).

experience.hook: Bow to a wild deer, and it bows back before it takes the cracker.
moments: Walk 10 minutes from Kintetsu Nara Station and meet the first deer on the grass.
Buy a pack of deer crackers (shika senbei), bow, and let the deer bow back.
Pass through the giant Nandaimon gate, then stand below the Great Buddha inside Todaiji.
Walk the moss-covered stone-lantern path up to Kasuga Taisha's red shrine.
Eat hot mochi from Nakatanidou near the station, famous for its fast mochi-pounding show.
experience.tip: Hide paper maps and snacks: the deer will eat them. Hold the crackers high until you are ready.
